question: A patient goes to a hospital emergency department presenting frank hematemesis. In the initial assessment the patient is pale and sweaty, has a heart rate of 110 beats per minute and a systolic blood pressure of 98 mmHg. Which of the following actions would NOT be performed in the initial care of this patient?

options.opa: Ensure adequate oxygenation of the patient.
options.opb: Channel two heavy gauge peripheral routes.
options.opc: Use the hematocrit as an index of blood loss.
options.opd: Replace the blood volume with crystalloid solutions.
